title: DreamWarden
description: A paid message from DreamWarden. The mattress that cares too much.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-shouty
lines.text: Sleep like a baby on the DreamWarden, the smart mattress that watches you all night for safety! <p:0.2> It learns your breathing, your secrets, your fears. <p:0.2> DreamWarden, it knows when you're awake!

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: The mattress retains everything it observes. <p:0> Do not attempt to sleep elsewhere. <p:0> DreamWarden has already contacted your mother. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
